summary: Master demand planning and S&OP with practical forecasting, KPI, and reconciliation tools. Build planning confidence and register your place today.
lede: Sales and operations planning (S&OP) helps demand planners and supply chain teams turn demand signals and capacity limits into a workable consensus plan. Training covers forecast accuracy and bias, time-series and driver-based forecasting, and demand, supply, and executive review routines. Participants practice reconciling forecasts, handling exceptions, aligning inventory and capacity, and reporting assumptions and decisions through planning packs and KPI dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage demand data, forecast reviews, planning meetings, and supply alignment. It is also suitable for adjacent roles that rely on the consensus plan to control inventory, capacity, and service performance.
prerequisites: You need access to a laptop, spreadsheet software such as Microsoft Excel, and a working familiarity with basic supply chain or planning terminology. Bringing a recent forecast file, demand review report, or S&OP agenda is helpful for the applied exercises.
